name: Blood & Blood Derivatives
aliases: blood, animal blood, blood powder, dried blood, blood plasma, plasma protein, blood plasma protein, haemoglobin, hemoglobin, haemoglobin powder, hemoglobin powder, blood protein, porcine blood, bovine blood
what_is: Animal blood and separated fractions of blood, including plasma, plasma proteins and haemoglobin. These ingredients can provide binding, gelling, water-retention or colour functions in meat products.
why_botia: Blood and its derivatives — plasma, haemoglobin and blood proteins — are used for binding, gelling or colour in sausages and other processed meat products. In products such as blood sausage the blood is obvious; in others it can appear as “plasma”, “plasma protein” or “haemoglobin”, terms that do not contain the word blood. Codex explicitly includes blood among the sources excluded from foods carrying a halal claim.
can_1: Detect blood, plasma, plasma protein, haemoglobin and related blood-derived terms when they are declared.
can_2: Explain that plasma and haemoglobin are blood fractions and show the animal-origin layer together with the objective Codex information relevant to a halal claim.
cannot_1: Determine the animal species when a generic term such as plasma or haemoglobin is used without a declared source.
cannot_2: Make a religious determination about whether a person should consider a specific food permissible; BOTIA only shows the declared ingredient and what the cited standard says.
